newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Eight dead, two injured in China building collapse.
newsitem.headline: Eight dead, two injured in China building collapse.

text.p: A seven-storey building in China collapsed on Tuesday killing eight people and injuring two, a Hong Kong newspaper reported on Friday.
Officials from Longchuan County in the southern China Guangdong province suspected the collapse was due to the foundation being undermined by a construction project next door, the Apple Daily said.
